where_to_look: Samsara's customers are trucking, construction and field-service fleets, so the demand signal is macro-observable in a way most SaaS is not: Class 8 truck orders/builds (ACT Research, FTR), DAT/Cass freight indices and truckload spot rates through July 2026 all cover the reported quarter

Net new ARR and the $100k+ ARR customer count are the two numbers the stock trades on. The relevant question is the seasonality of Q2 net-new ARR versus a full-year guide that IOT has habitually set conservatively and raised
Public-sector and international: Samsara has been pushing state/municipal fleet and European expansion. Government fleet-telematics procurement awards in the window are public record

Competitive displacement evidence: Motive (private) is the direct competitor and its funding/customer announcements plus Geotab and Lytx activity through August 2026 are the only observable share signal
22.8x-plus revenue multiple on 5 estimates - the room is in the guide, not the quarter, and an 11.27% implied move is modest against IOT's own post-print history
